reviewScope: Exact common adapter candidate and pure builder reproduction
Early verified review/plan holds and complete public/source hold inventories
A10 public metadata, current-SID private ACL/path guards and bounded credential handoff
Reviewed window, child lifetime, output whitelist and cleanup

findingResolution.evidence: All frozen children accept canonical generatedPlan. Health/Scheduler reject conflicting legacy aliases. All three --preflight entry points return passed/networkCalls/privateInputsRead/planSha256/finalReviewSha256 as required by the adapter.

The common adapter acquires verified review hold before reading review, then verified plan hold before asserting/reading plan. It enumerates source/public inventories only after these holds. It embeds the same f8b82f70... helper tested by disposable Windows controls.

verifiedProperties: Pure builder exactly reproduces the frozen candidate from the preserved template; malformed source population and changed template are refused.
All three child hashes and the A10 helper hash match actual public source files; no unresolved source marker remains.
Complete source/public inventories and explicit source/plan/review/metadata/self holds precede any child.
Validate completes the bounded public-only child preflight and exits before Windows SID, private metadata or DPAPI access.
Execute requires exact project, runtime bundle, A10 helper, current SID, private temp folder/token/metadata paths, protected current-SID ACLs and identical private/public metadata.
Metadata must be fresh, positive-lived, at most 120 minutes and valid through the reviewed end. Reviewed start/end and a 90-second reserve are checked before credential handoff.
Final source/metadata/review/plan hashes are rechecked immediately before DPAPI while the public holds remain active.
Private stdin contains exactly projectId, bundleSha256 and ownerToken. No runtime encryption key or Auth/session payload is added.
New-TaskProcess uses separate ArgumentList entries, closed preflight stdin, direct hidden execution and removes inherited SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN.
Public results are reconstructed from a small whitelist; unexpected error strings map to a bounded diagnostic. Plaintext strings/BSTR/secure string and child/held handles have cleanup paths.
